notes.title: The CAVE update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32842515/7c81457b02e558659cb19e62affa9d48a35e9137.png[/img]
[h1]Breaking News![/h1]
Mysterious never before seen cave entrance has been spotted at Whispering Waters!
Scientists are puzzled why this cave had not been discovered before however the entrance was heavily overgrown by the local flora.
Adding to the mystery is that the cave does not appear in any of Misty Falls historical records which could indicate that the inside might as well have never been witnessed by any human being.
Who knows which secrets lay hidden? Could it contain species that have yet to be discovered?
Who knows? Even we don't know! That's why we don't even have a changelog for you (yet)! ;)

[h2]The Cave Update is out now![/h2]
Get ready to explore the mysterious cave and help us reveal its secrets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32842515/ee100424c61ca694bb08ec7609d45127a8a0e0fd.png[/img]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES v.1.3.1
notes.content:
Bonfish, my friends of fishing!

Since the release of Catch & Release, we got a lot of great feedback and suggestions from you guys.
The single most requested one was this:

MisterMxyzptlk: Any chance of getting a WEATHER update in the future with some rain?
BeeSawd: Moving/randomized clouds I know it sounds small but this one little thing would be fantastic, being able look up and just stare at the clouds for a bit would be fantastic, (...).
capnsoup: (...) maybe a light WEATHER system along with moving clouds? (...).
HerpicleOmnicron: I've got fond memories of fishing while watching the rain ripple on the water and tapping on the umbrella. Rainy fishing's great!
ragesaq: There needs to be WEATHER. (...)

So we got some GOOD NEWS for all the fans of BAD WEATHER.

HERE IS THE WEATHER UPDATE that will add a complete dynamic weather system to the game.

v.1.3.1 (3948207) - Weather Update

- Added 2 new fish
- Added dynamic clouds
- Added rain effects
- Added fog effects
- Added lightning effects
- Enhanced wind effects
- Added rain, wind and thunder sound effects
- Added fishing gloves
- Added rain hat
- Remastered audio mix
- Updated postprocess effects
- Fixed double sun reflection on water
- Fixed rare issue with missing cooler
- Fixed rare issue with caught fish getting stuck

Also the overall audio mix has been remastered.
In @ Faarborgs words: The new update improves immersion by about 300%

Bacon cannot solve all problems, but that is why we have VR fishing!

Please enjoy this update and bon fishing for all!
The team.

notes.title: Foundation Update NOW ON BETA CHANNEL!
notes.content:
Sorry for the long silence and thanks for your patience everybody!
The exciting news of course is that we were (and still are) working hard on new updates for Catch & Release and we are proud to announce the (Steam) public beta of the Foundation Update today.
As the name implies this is just the foundation we will build upon with our next updates.
And I know that you guys want to know what those updates are and what the content is... but we will announce this as we develop and release them. 
Leave a little surprise :)

Anyways... first update, some fundamentals that needed fixing and adding.... and onwards and upwards!

We did change a lot under the hood. A major engine upgrade is just one of those changes.
We also incorporated a lot of your usability feedback:

- Multiple save slots
- Option for imperial units
- Option to disable Snap turn
- Separate SFX and ambience audio settings
- (Re)moving the 'Reset game' button.

And made a lot of other usability improvements:

- Complete shop overhaul
- Menu overhaul
- Performance improvements
...

Join our public beta channel on Discord for a full list or any other feedback you want to share or discuss.
The invite for the channel is: https://discord.gg/y9Tzus7

As always - with big changes there is the risk of unforeseen bugs and glitches.
That's why we invite you all to participate in the public beta.

How to participate:
1. Right click the game in your Steam library
2. Select Properties >  BETAS > beta - beta
3. Backup your savegames: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\userdata[steam ID]\679750\remote
4. Post your feedback in the #public-beta channel

notes.title: v.1.1.1 (2975833) - Update 1 : The call of the Wild
notes.content:
Good day one and all,

We hope you’re all enjoying the massive heatwave (or relaxing in an ice cave). Despite the face-melting temperatures we pried open our ears and listened to your feedback. What we heard was mainly: More content! So that’s what we did. The first content update is here.

Woohoo!

Now, we bet you’re wondering: What did they do? Sometimes we’re even wondering that ourselves. But in this case, we thought it would be cool if we leave some stuff for you to discover on your own! Can’t discover anything, if you know everything already, right?

So here’s a little list to feast your eyes upon:

We added some BIG animals. Just hang out on the lake and see if you can spot ‘em!

We added also some SMALL animals! Go out and about and see if you can find these!

We have also added some NEW FISH! What… really? We did? YES WE DID!!1!!

MOAR? Of course. Ain’t no show unless there’s an encore.

We also added some lures to play (and lure) with.

And that is that!

Just kidding, raise the curtain back up real quick.
There’s also, FIXES!:

- A new mechanic to unlock new fish descriptions.
- Fixed hands being visible while holding fishing rod.
- Fixed wrong (additional) button highlight in tutorial.
- Enhanced controller visibility during tutorials.

"If you can think of a better fish pun, let minnow"
- The Team

notes.title: METRICMINDS ANNOUNCES RELEASE DATE FOR VR FISHING GAME CATCH & RELEASE FOR THE STEAM & OCULUS STORE
notes.content:
[h1]Beautiful VR fishing game with a twist - [b]Catch & Release[/b] to release on June 7th for the Steam & Oculus store[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32842515/444a11fe0bbec514bedd366ccdd3cdfab11eb058.png[/img]

Frankfurt – 24th May 2018 – Internationally renowned game services company METRICMINDS GmbH & Co. KG has announced their first VR project called [b]“Catch & Release”[/b]. The game will bring its brand of meditative, relaxed virtual reality fishing to the Steam & Oculus store on [b]June 7th, 2018.[/b]

[b]Catch & Release[/b] is a virtual reality fishing experience like no other - It combines the inherently relaxing activity of fishing on a lake with beautiful surroundings and game mechanics that take a step back to let the player enjoy their time on a virtual fishing trip freely and without stressful distractions like timers or forced missions. The game features one of the most beautiful environments in VR, brought to life with dense nature, local fauna like geese and bears and diverse, interesting fishing spots and landscape features. The colourful art style supports the goal of immersing the player in a peaceful world free from stressful distractions that lets players decide they way they want to play the game.

Players can enjoy their time in the game freely, or they can pick up missions and challenges to progress and unlock new gear and items for themselves.

[b]Catch & Release Features:[/b]
[list]
    [*]The Boat - Use the unique rowing mechanics to find the best fishing spots and explore the beautiful environment.
    [*]The Fishing Rod - Throw the line out and attract a fish - Your interactive fishing rod offers you full control, with different bait and lures and haptic feedback.
    [*]The Shop - Sell your fish and buy new gear and items in the in-game shop!
    [*]Fishing - Catch the biggest fish, fight to reel them in, but don't let them snap the line and escape! You'll need strategy and finesse to tire them out if you want to make the greatest catch!
[*]Secrets - Find trash or treasure. The lake hides more than just fish!
[*]Music - Over 30 commercial tracks that have been specially curated for [b]Catch & Release[/b] playing on the in-game boat radio. Licensed by Flip Entertainment, the tracks were selected to enhance the in-game music with a non-standard selection aimed at improving the overall immersive experience.

[/list]
 
[b]Catch & Release[/b] is set to launch for the Steam & Oculus store on the [b]7th of June 2018[/b] with a PSVR version scheduled to be available in summer of 2018.
